name: @poesygen/desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for the shared PoesyGen web client
author: PoesyGen

scripts.package:mac: pnpm run package:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac zip --universal
scripts.package:mac:dmg: pnpm run package:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --universal
scripts.preview: pnpm --filter @poesygen/web build && pnpm run build && electron dist/main.js --built
